turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So Donna is a 37 -year-old female she is here with complaint of headache she has a history of hypertension and diabetes so Donna tell me what's going on

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah lately I've just been having quite a bit of a headache and I mean every now and then I'll get it but lately it's just been getting worse and I've noticed that my blood pressure has been running high I've been taking it maybe like once a week but the past three weeks it's been really high than usual so I was a little worried

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you remember the numbers that you're getting on your blood pressure readings

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah so one of them was like one sixty over eighty seven and then the last one was like one seventy five over ninety two

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay so it's really high I was looking back and it looks like your blood pressure was pretty normal last time we saw you is one twenty four over eighty two have you been able to take your blood pressure medicine the lisinopril that you've been prescribed

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I have but sometimes I forget I'm I'm embarrassed to tell you that but yeah sometimes I forget I get busy like especially on the weekends I'm very good during the week but on the weekends I tend to forget it and that's when I'm most busy too

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah well I'm also curious you know you have diabetes have you been checking your blood sugar

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah I have because I thought maybe you know that's why I'm getting the headaches maybe my sugar was too low or maybe too high but my sugar has been okay it's been running like one twenty sometimes it does get down to like one hundred

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay and have you noticed are you urinating more than usual or anything like that

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not really so much it's it's been pretty much the same but pretty normal

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay and when you get these headaches what are you taking for them

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well I take my tylenol hoping it'll just you know go away and then it does some just for a little bit but then it it just goes throughout the day and I start to get them again

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay and when you first had the headaches what would you rate the headache at zero no pain ten the worst pain ever

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say when I first get them it's about I would say a seven out of ten

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And then after you take the tylenol what does it go down to

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It goes down to probably about a four maybe five it I still feel it I still feel annoying but it's not as pounding as as it normally would be

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: If I didn't take the tylenol

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah and have you ever had headaches like this before

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not like this you know you know as you know sometimes I get migraine but I know I never really take anything for it that's like once a year or once or every two years but not like not like this one headaches like this one

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay and have you had any congestion anything like that cough runny nose

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah I thought maybe because you know now it's springtime and I tend to get my allergies but it it's it's very different and I've not actually had any like runny nose or cough or congestion along with the headache

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay if you tap on your forehead do you have any tenderness

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Right here

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just a little not really too much

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay if you tap down here on these bones your cheek bones any tenderness there

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: A little bit not as much as I guess if I tap up here

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay and then if you kinda push on your neck around here any tenderness

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It it's a little tender but it's not it is a little bit I'd say

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay okay so you don't have any frontal sinus tenderness no maxillary sinus tenderness it sounds like you don't have any lymphadenopathy that would just be if your lymph nodes were tender so yeah you know let's just talk about a few things that I wan na do and then I want you to actually come in and and be seen by doctor ruth so first off your headache I think taking tylenol is great you can keep taking that you know your lisinopril you're on twenty milligrams once a day which is a medium dose but I think we can increase that so for your hypertension and your headaches I'm gon na have you increase your lisinopril to forty milligrams once a day

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And then I want you to keep checking your blood pressure and I wan na order some blood tests I'd like to get some just normal blood work we'll get a hemoglobin a1c some laboratory tests things like that and and then for your diabetes I'm gon na have some diabetic education for you that I want you to be able to review it sounds like your blood sugar has been running a little bit high and after you get the blood tests after that's all done I want you to come in to see me or doctor ruth and we'll just make sure that everything is okay that we get your blood pressure under control any questions for me

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No I mean I've been walking and I know I get the headaches but is it alright if I still continue my walks

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah that's great I think exercise is wonderful for everything going on go ahead and walk still

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay great we'll do that thank you

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You're welcome thanks so much Donna
